scope: Native CPU ONNX load, forward and segmentation decode on three independent CRDLD validation images; not a navigation accuracy or temporal replay evaluation
runner: rk/apps/onnx_segment_image.cpp at the pinned SDK source commit
timing_definition: inference_ms covers letterbox, blob construction and network forward; excludes model loading, mask decoding, image IO, undistortion, BEV and ROS transport. One process/call per sample, not a steady-state benchmark.
visual_review: Inspected original and non-empty mask of sample 0; multiple row bands and scattered edge fragments are visible. No quantitative accuracy acceptance.
navigation_validation: Pending matched, accepted intrinsic and vehicle-ground BEV calibration. No calibration acceptance flags were changed.
